concept: SCP: deny disabling CloudTrail in all Organizations accounts
tests: How to guarantee nobody in the OU's accounts (admins included) can disable CloudTrail.
expected: An SCP on the OU with Deny cloudtrail:StopLogging sets the maximum permissions for every principal in member accounts. Triggers: "regardless of IAM permissions", AWS Organizations, OU.
why_not: A permissions boundary is attached per principal and can be bypassed by the account admin; a trail resource policy and Config rules don't prevent the action.
